input.description: Validate v4 UUID format from getRandomValues fallback

input.command:
cd "C:/Users/maury/Documents/Murf Challenge" && git add frontend/lib/utils.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(frontend): UUID fallback for non-secure contexts (LAN IP over http)

crypto.randomUUID() is secure-context only — available on localhost but
undefined on a bare LAN IP over plain http, which crashed getCallerId() and
blocked the dashboard from loading via the network URL. Fall back to a
getRandomValues-based v4 UUID (no secure-context gate), keeping the same id
format so stored ids and the backend are unaffected.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" && git log --oneline -1
